descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S05 Existing specs: AI call kind × failure — each failure is visible, offers a retry and keeps what was entered

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • T2 Each error tells the physician what to do next (retry, check connection, enable permission, sign in) in plain language in the app's existing style (TFA-94745 AC 5; TFA-94745 AC 1)
  • U1 When the network drops or an AI provider times out mid-dictation or mid-note-generation, the app retries automatically rather than hanging indefinitely; … (UAT OAT-03 step 1; UAT OAT-03 step 2; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-92568 AC 5)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Tim's chromium fixtures; one AI action per test fails at the Convex socket

When Pre-round summary (Save Note), billing suggestion, pasted prior-note extraction, Save & Extract medication / task extraction, the course refresh after Generate (both contexts)

Then Summary: note text kept, error and a visible retry. Billing: note still shown, 'Couldn't generate billing suggestion — tap to retry', the code appears on tap. Prior note: note text kept, retry from the UI. Save & Extract: the half that succeeded is kept when the other fails. Course refresh: today's line still finished in Hospital and Nursing Home

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. Summary and billing are Hospital only. Nursing Home pre-round summary, Ask AI and handoff have no failure spec: S06 forces them; no Nursing Home billing failure spec exists (recorded). These inject a client-side failure, so they show the failure state, not the server's automatic retry (S03)

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S05

Existing specs: AI call kind × failure — each failure is visible, offers a retry and keeps what was entered

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/OAT-03.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • billing-suggestion.spec.ts [chromium] — a failed suggestion stays visible and retries on tap — expected
  • chart.spec.ts [chromium] — a structured-summary failure keeps the reviewed note and a visible retry — expected
  • course-timeline.spec.ts [chromium] — a failed hospital course refresh still leaves today's line finished — expected
  • course-timeline.spec.ts [chromium] — a failed nursing-home course refresh still leaves today's line finished — expected
  • medication-detection.spec.ts [chromium] — Save & Extract keeps medication updates when task extraction fails — expected
  • medication-detection.spec.ts [chromium] — Save & Extract keeps task updates when medication extraction fails — expected
  • prior-note-import.spec.ts [chromium] — a failed prior-note extraction keeps the note visible and retries from the UI — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's chromium specs chart, billing-suggestion, prior-note-import, medication-detection and course-timeline): each test makes a fresh @roundai.test account with the local admin key and fails one AI action at the Convex socket (action-observer).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
